rows.reasoning: Caballero's only evidence is an Aye vote on SB 188 (2019-2020), a near-unanimous floor vote (Ayes Count 37 Noes Count 0); she is not the bill's author (Mitchell) and no own words tie her to the provision, so per the annex's near-unanimous rule this cannot establish rung 2 ('strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination') alone, even though the bill's content fits it well.
